title: KeyChain mint request
description: Body of POST /agents/mint and POST /agents/register. The ACP v2 register contract is the subset {brand, repo_locale, ordinal_path, parent_agent_uuid, role, medium, session_id}; every other property is a KeyChain extension with a safe default.

brand.description: Agent vendor or runtime, for example 'cursor'. Trimmed and lowercased.

repo_locale.description: Repository or workspace the agent operates in, for example 'iac-bus'.

ordinal_path.description: Position in the agent tree. Omit to mint the master ordinal '0', or the next free child of the given parent.

logical_handle.description: Alternative to brand/repo_locale/ordinal_path. Any component also supplied must agree with it.

parent_agent_uuid.description: Required for any non-master ordinal path.

parent_handle.description: The parent named by logical handle instead of UUID.

role.description: Determines the default capability set. Defaults to 'worker'.

medium.description: Transport the endpoint handle is qualified with. Required by /agents/register; defaults to 'api' for /agents/mint.

capabilities.description: Requested capabilities. Must be within what the issuer holds; defaults to the role's set.

custody.description: 'agent' returns the private key once and KeyChain keeps only the public half. 'keychain' seals the private key so KeyChain can sign delegated certificates and self-contained tokens for this agent.

public_key.description: An OKP JWK the agent generated itself. Supply this to keep the private key entirely off the KeyChain host.

issuer.description: Who signs the new certificate. 'auto' prefers the parent and falls back to the trust root.

root.description: Trust root to mint under, by root_id, name or key_id. Defaults to the instance default root.

ttl_seconds.description: Certificate lifetime. Clamped to the issuer's remaining validity.
